# L.A. Tech & Media Law Firm

> Los Angeles-based tech and media law firm specializing in intellectual property, startup legal services, and business litigation for digital companies.

L.A. Tech & Media Law Firm (LATML), led by principal attorney David Nima Sharifi, provides comprehensive legal services to tech startups, entrepreneurs, and media companies in Los Angeles and beyond. The firm focuses on IP protection, transactional deals, litigation, and emerging technology law including AI and entertainment.

## Key Topics

- Intellectual Property
- Trademark Litigation
- Patent Law
- Copyright Law
- Startup Legal Services
- Business Formation
- M&A Due Diligence
- TTAB Proceedings
- Entertainment Law
- Technology Law
- Brand Protection
- Trademark Registration
- Business Litigation
- Venture Capital
- AI & New Media Law
